_comment: For AI agents: Supply one program in activities to fill a programming task editor. Set title and Markdown prompt. mode=stdout uses main.cpp and input/output cases; mode=unit supports main.cpp, task_name.cpp, task_name.h and cases with code. reference contains literal C++, minutes is a positive solving limit or an empty string, logs is boolean, and each check is off, warn or block. Defaults: logs=false, format=block, static=warn, dynamic=warn. Use mode=none for a program without tests; omit cases or use an empty array.
